airspace.zh: 依當地規定，在泰德國家公園飛無人機，只有在取得明確許可時才允許，許可主要只核發給有正當理由的專業拍攝；國家公園、野生動物保護區與生物圈保護區內，不允許休閒用途。2016年曾有人因未經許可以無人機拍攝泰德峰，被罰款600歐元。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Under local rules, drones may only be flown in Teide National Park with express permission, granted mainly for justified professional filming; recreational use is not allowed in national parks, wildlife conservation zones or biosphere reserves. In 2016 a man was fined €600 for filming Teide with a drone without permission. Check the current rules before any real flight.

title.en: A Volcanic Beacon in the Atlantic

tagline.zh-Hant: 關契人的聖山、哥倫布看見的火、1706年被熔岩改變的港口，到2007年的世界遺產
tagline.en: The Guanches' sacred peak, the fire Columbus saw, a port changed by lava in 1706, World Heritage in 2007

zh: 泰德峰在大西洋上的特內里費島，
海拔三千七百一十五公尺，是西班牙的最高峰。
en: Mount Teide stands on Tenerife in the Atlantic,
3,715 metres high, the highest peak in Spain.

zh: 島上原本的居民是關契人，
他們把泰德峰看作神聖的山。
en: The original people of the island were the Guanches,
who held Teide to be sacred.

zh: 他們相信，惡靈瓜約塔住在山裡；
火山噴發時，他們點起篝火，想把他嚇走。
en: They believed the evil being Guayota lived inside the mountain;
during eruptions they lit bonfires to frighten him away.

zh: 關契人主要以放牧為生，
夏天會把羊群帶到高處的卡尼亞達斯。
en: The Guanches were mainly herders
who spent their summers up in Las Cañadas.

zh: 國家公園裡發現了許多關契人的考古遺跡，
證明這片高地曾經是他們的生活場所。
en: Many Guanche archaeological remains have been found in the park,
showing these uplands were part of their life.

zh: 1492年，哥倫布航向美洲途中，
記下他看見「奧羅塔瓦山谷裡的大火」。
en: In 1492, on his way to the Americas,
Columbus recorded seeing "a great fire in the Orotava Valley".

zh: 後來的定年顯示，那時奧羅塔瓦並沒有噴發，
噴發的是另一處火山口。
en: Later dating suggests there was no eruption in the Orotava Valley then;
another vent was erupting.

zh: 北岸的加拉奇科，在1496年西班牙征服之後建立，
曾是出口馬姆齊葡萄酒的重要港口。
en: Garachico, on the north coast, was founded in 1496 after the conquest
and became an important port exporting Malmsey wine.

zh: 1706年5月5日，西北方的火山裂谷噴發，
熔岩流進舊港灣，斷了小鎮的生計。
en: On 5 May 1706 the north-west rift zone erupted,
and lava ran into the old bay, ending the town's livelihood.

zh: 第一次有紀錄的登頂，是在1582年。
1798年，老峰的西側噴發了三個月。
en: The first recorded ascent of Teide was in 1582.
In 1798 the western flank of Pico Viejo erupted for three months.

zh: 1909年11月18日，西北方的奇涅羅火山口噴發，
是特內里費島到今天為止的最後一次噴發。
en: On 18 November 1909 the Chinyero vent to the north-west erupted,
the last eruption on Tenerife to date.

zh: 1954年1月22日，泰德國家公園成立，
面積後來擴大到約一百九十平方公里。
en: Teide National Park was created on 22 January 1954
and later enlarged to about 190 square kilometres.

zh: 1964年，泰德天文台在海拔兩千三百九十公尺啟用，
由加那利天文物理研究所管理。
en: In 1964 the Teide Observatory opened at 2,390 metres,
run by the Instituto de Astrofísica de Canarias.

zh: 1989年，公園獲得歐洲理事會的歐洲文憑最高等級；
2007年6月28日，列入世界遺產。
en: In 1989 the park received the Council of Europe's European Diploma in its highest category;
on 28 June 2007 it became a World Heritage Site.

zh: 2016年，公園有四百零七萬多人次造訪，
是西班牙遊客最多的國家公園。
en: In 2016 the park had more than 4.07 million visits,
the most of any national park in Spain.

zh: 從關契人的聖山、航海者的地標，
到研究星空的高地，泰德峰一直站在大西洋上。
en: From the Guanches' sacred peak and the sailors' landmark
to a high place for studying the sky, Teide has always stood over the Atlantic.

tagline.zh-Hant: 瓜約塔的傳說、一千元比塞塔紙鈔上的岩石、電影的外景地，與每天兩百人的登頂許可
tagline.en: The Guayota legend, a rock on a banknote, a film location and a summit permit for 200 a day

zh: 在關契人的信仰裡，泰德峰是神聖的山，
惡靈瓜約塔被認為就住在火山裡。
en: In Guanche belief Teide was a sacred mountain,
and the evil being Guayota was thought to live inside it.

zh: 火山噴發時，人們點燃篝火，
希望把瓜約塔嚇回山裡。
en: When the volcano erupted, people lit bonfires
hoping to scare Guayota away.

zh: 加西亞岩群裡的辛查多岩，高約二十七公尺，
也被叫做「石樹」或「上帝的手指」。
en: Roque Cinchado, in the Roques de García, is about 27 metres tall,
and is also called the Stone Tree or the Finger of God.

zh: 它曾經印在西班牙一千元比塞塔紙鈔的背面，
背景就是泰德峰。
en: It once appeared on the back of Spain's 1,000-peseta banknote,
with Teide behind it.

zh: 從觀景台出發的環狀步道約三點五公里，
大約兩小時，遊客必須走在圍起來的步道上。
en: A circular trail of about 3.5 km from the viewpoint
takes about two hours, and visitors must keep to the fenced path.

zh: 纜車從海拔兩千三百五十六公尺，
大約八分鐘就升到三千五百五十五公尺。
en: The cable car climbs from 2,356 metres
to 3,555 metres in about eight minutes.

zh: 最後兩百公尺到山頂，需要免費的許可證，
通常每天限兩百人。
en: The last 200 metres to the summit need a free permit,
normally limited to 200 people a day.

zh: 這片像外星球的地景，常被電影拿來當外景，
包括1966年與2010年的幾部電影。
en: This otherworldly landscape is a favourite film location,
including One Million Years B.C. (1966) and Clash of the Titans (2010).

zh: 加拉奇科是由熱那亞的銀行家德蓬特建立的。
2025年，小鎮約有四千九百四十位居民。
en: Garachico was founded by the Genoese banker Cristóbal de Ponte.
In 2025 it had about 4,940 residents.

zh: 常聽說1706年的熔岩毀了整座城鎮，
但實際上，小鎮只是部分被毀。
en: It is often said that the lava of 1706 destroyed the whole town,
but in fact it was only partly destroyed.

zh: 天文台這裡的大氣視寧度很好，
吸引了許多國家來這裡設置望遠鏡。
en: The seeing here is very good,
and it has drawn telescopes from many countries.

zh: 德國的格雷戈爾太陽望遠鏡，口徑一點五公尺，
2012年5月開始運作。
en: The German GREGOR solar telescope, 1.5 metres across,
has operated since May 2012.

zh: 法國與義大利的忒彌斯太陽望遠鏡，在1996年建成；
德國的真空塔望遠鏡，在1989年裝設。
en: The French–Italian THEMIS solar telescope was built in 1996;
the German Vacuum Tower Telescope was installed in 1989.

zh: 依規定，在泰德國家公園飛無人機，必須有明確的許可；
休閒用途在國家公園裡是不允許的。
en: By the rules, flying a drone in Teide National Park needs express permission;
recreational use is not allowed in national parks.

zh: 傳說、紙鈔、電影與天文台，
都把這座火山，寫進了人們的生活裡。
en: Legends, a banknote, films and an observatory
have all written this volcano into people's lives.

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩百多種植物、只長在公園裡的特有種、三公尺高的紅色泰德藍薊，與藍色的燕雀
tagline.en: Over 200 plant species, endemics found only in the park, the red Teide bugloss and the blue chaffinch

zh: 公園裡有兩百多種維管束植物：
三十一種是加那利群島特有，三十三種只在特內里費島。
en: The park has over 200 vascular plant species:
31 are endemic to the Canaries and 33 to Tenerife.

zh: 其中有六種，
全世界只長在這座國家公園裡。
en: Six of them
grow nowhere in the world but this national park.

zh: 泰德藍薊，可以長到三公尺高，
春天開出數百朵紅色的小花。
en: Teide bugloss can grow 3 metres tall,
covered in spring with hundreds of small red flowers.

zh: 泰德堇菜長在海拔兩千五百公尺以上的火山渣上，
一直分布到山頂附近。
en: The Teide violet grows on scoria and pumice above 2,500 metres,
right up towards the summit.

zh: 最常見的灌木，是泰德白金雀花。
2002到2017年，它在公園裡的覆蓋率少了百分之十七點五。
en: The dominant shrub is the Teide white broom.
From 2002 to 2017 it lost 17.5% of its cover in the park.

zh: 在海拔約一千到兩千一百公尺的山腰，
是加那利松的森林。
en: On the middle slopes, from about 1,000 to 2,100 metres,
grow forests of Canary pine.

zh: 無脊椎動物估計約有一千四百種，
大約一半是群島特有。
en: There are an estimated 1,400 invertebrate species,
about half of them endemic to the islands.

zh: 岩石間常見的加那利蜥蜴，
是公園三種特有的爬蟲類之一。
en: The Canary lizard, often seen among the rocks,
is one of the park's three endemic reptiles.

zh: 特有的藍燕雀在松林裡築巢，
也常常飛到公園裡來。
en: The blue chaffinch nests in the pine belt
and regularly visits the park.

zh: 公園裡還有五種蝙蝠。
綿羊和山羊，在原住民時代就被帶到島上。
en: The park also has five species of bat.
Sheep and goats arrived in aboriginal times.

zh: 兔子和老鼠，在十五世紀末來到島上；
為了打獵引進的兔子，至今仍需控制。
en: Rabbits and rats arrived in the late 15th century;
the rabbits, brought in for hunting, still have to be controlled.

zh: 外來的歐洲盤羊，也在二十世紀後期被引進；
2021年春天的普查，只數到十二隻。
en: The Corsican mouflon was introduced in the late 20th century;
the spring 2021 census counted only 12.

zh: 2021年的一場火災，
燒到了稀有的瓜哈拉堇菜族群附近。
en: A fire in 2021
came close to a population of the rare Guajara violet.

zh: 每年約四百三十萬名遊客中，
大約七成開車、兩成八搭遊覽車進來。
en: Of some 4.3 million visitors a year,
about 70% arrive by car and 28% by tour bus.

zh: 在看似荒涼的火山地上，
開著世界上其他地方沒有的花。
en: On ground that looks barren,
flowers bloom that grow nowhere else on Earth.

title.zh-Hant: 從海底算起七千五百公尺

tagline.zh-Hant: 崩塌後長出的泰德峰、十七公里寬的卡尼亞達斯火山口、老峰的大火山口，與最後一次噴發
tagline.en: Teide grown after a collapse, the 17 km Las Cañadas caldera, the crater of Pico Viejo and the last eruptions

zh: 從海底算起，泰德峰高約七千五百公尺，
是地球上第三高的火山結構。
en: Measured from the ocean floor, Teide rises about 7,500 metres,
the third-tallest volcanic structure on Earth.

zh: 它大約在十七萬年前，
一場災難性的山崩之後開始成形。
en: It began to form about 170,000 years ago,
after a catastrophic landslide.

zh: 山頂高約三千七百一十八公尺，
頂上的火山口直徑大約八十公尺。
en: The summit is about 3,718 metres high,
with a crater about 80 metres across.

zh: 山下是卡尼亞達斯火山口，寬約十七公里，
四周的岩壁最高約七百公尺。
en: Below lies the Las Cañadas caldera, about 17 km across,
its walls up to 700 metres high.

zh: 加西亞岩群，是島上舊山頂殘留下來的岩石，
被侵蝕分割成一座座岩塔。
en: The Roques de García are remnants of the island's former summit,
split by erosion into towers of rock.

zh: 辛查多岩的上部，有兩道熔岩岩床侵入，
讓它比下面更耐侵蝕。
en: Two lava sills intruded into the upper part of Roque Cinchado,
making it more resistant to erosion than the rock below.

zh: 岩群旁的烏坎卡平原，
是國家公園裡最大的谷地。
en: The Llano de Ucanca beside the rocks
is the largest valley in the national park.

zh: 往西北，是老峰，海拔約三千一百三十公尺，
是加那利群島第二高的火山。
en: To the north-west rises Pico Viejo, about 3,130 metres,
the second-highest volcano in the Canary Islands.

zh: 老峰的火山口直徑大約七百二十公尺。
1798年西側噴發了三個月，流出約一千兩百萬立方公尺熔岩。
en: The crater of Pico Viejo is about 720 metres across.
In 1798 its western flank erupted for three months, pouring out some 12 million m³ of lava.

zh: 那次噴發留下的黑色熔岩，
被叫做「泰德的鼻孔」。
en: The black lava of that eruption
is known as the Narices del Teide, "the nostrils of Teide".

zh: 1706年，西北裂谷上的火山噴發，
熔岩流進了加拉奇科的港灣。
en: In 1706 a vent on the north-west rift erupted,
and lava poured into Garachico's harbour.

zh: 1909年，西北裂谷上的奇涅羅噴發，
是特內里費島最近一次的噴發。
en: In 1909 El Chinyero erupted on the north-west rift,
the most recent eruption on Tenerife.

zh: 東北方的多爾薩爾山脊，是一條火山裂谷；
1704到1705年，這條裂谷上曾接連噴發。
en: The Cordillera Dorsal ridge to the north-east is a volcanic rift;
it erupted several times in 1704 and 1705.

zh: 不過，這個「第三高」的排名，
是把夏威夷的火山當成一個整體來算的。
en: That "third-tallest" ranking, though,
counts the volcanoes of Hawaii as a single structure.

zh: 從海底升起的這座火山，
還在慢慢書寫特內里費島的地形。
en: This volcano, risen from the sea floor,
is still slowly shaping the land of Tenerife.
